query.content: The lithium chapters of Mineral Commodity Summaries 2019-2025, extracted from the full volumes and concatenated into one file. The sha256 is of this extracted file, not of any volume.
query.url_verification: pubs.usgs.gov is unreachable from the environment that archived this file (egress policy), so the 2020-2025 URLs are recorded from the published USGS naming and were not re-fetched here. The 2019 edition predates that naming; its official page was confirmed to exist by the reviewer on 2026-09-14 (lithium-mcs-2019-data-sheet, mcs-2019-lithi.pdf, 167.03 KB). The archived bytes, not the URL, are what the extraction was run against.
